name: Lemongrass Chicken with Jasmine Rice

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.original: 2 lemongrass stalks, white part finely chopped

steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, brown sugar and half the oil in a bowl, add the chicken and turn it through. Leave for 20 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Cook the jasmine rice by the absorption method and keep it covered.
Heat the remaining oil in a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat. Lift the chicken from the marinade, letting the excess drip off, and lay the pieces in without crowding the pan.
Cook for 5 minutes a side, until the sugar in the marinade has caramelised to a dark lacquer and the chicken is cooked through.
Pour the leftover marinade into the pan, let it bubble for a minute to cook out, and spoon it over the chicken.
Slice the chicken and serve on the rice with the cucumber, carrot, coriander and lime wedges.
